---
title: "Synthetic demonstration -- no study data"
---

This deterministic fixture illustrates report rendering only. All values below
are constructed here; they are unrelated to the project question or datasets.
No data are read and no files are written by the code chunks.

```{r synthetic-data}
x <- 0:5
residual <- c(1, -2, 1, 1, -2, 1)
demo <- data.frame(x = x, y = 1 + 2 * x + residual)
knitr::kable(demo, caption = "Synthetic values only")
```

## Continuous-outcome fixture

The construction has intercept 1 and slope 2. These assertions check the
fixture, not a scientific hypothesis.

```{r synthetic-model}
fit <- stats::lm(y ~ x, data = demo)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(unname(stats::coef(fit)), c(1, 2))))
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(summary(fit)$coefficients), digits = 3,
  caption = "Synthetic least-squares fit; no study inference")
```
